name: Knowunity: AI Study & Homework
description:
Hey, I'm Knowie - your new way of learning. Whatever you're working on, I'll help you understand it, remember it, and walk into your next SAT, ACT, or AP feeling ready. 30 million students already study with me, I am created by the best students and the core tools are free.

This is a the new way of learning - here is how we do it. Everything runs through one place: your exam plan. Instead of a pile of separate features, I pull it all together - flashcards, quizzes, summaries, mock exams, voice practice, and the official SAT, ACT, and AP guidelines - and structure it into a day-by-day plan built around your test date and your topics.

Your exam plan, made with you. Tell me when your test is and what you need to cover, and I'll map out exactly what to do each day, with the right notes and flashcards for your course. Add your class timetable and I'll fit study around your lessons - no all-nighters. As the test gets closer the plan adapts, and you always see what you've got down and what's next.

Study that actually sticks - active recall. Rereading feels productive but fades fast, so your plan is built around active recall: pulling answers out of your own memory. Quizzes and flashcards ask you to remember, not just recognize, and mastery tracking shows each topic move from shaky to solid.

Just say it out loud. This is where voice comes in. With voice recall in your plan, you say your answer from memory and I check it with you - hands-free, out loud, the way real recall works.

name: Stupid Simple Macro Tracker
description:
Join 2.7 million people who chose simplicity over stress.

Stupid Simple Macro Tracker is the app people switch to when they're done fighting with the other guys.
Tired of cluttered dashboards, screen-hijacking ads, and menus that make logging a simple food feel like filing your taxes? Done paying annual subscription fees that keep climbing? We took a different path — and 2.7 million users agree it was the right one.

What makes us different:
* Actually simple — log a meal in seconds with custom food icons you build once and tap forever. Most users are up and running in minutes, not days
* The Food Bank — save up calories for date night, a party, or the weekend without blowing your goals
* Positive habit forming — our clean, judgment-free layout makes tracking so quick and painless that users tell us they never miss a day
* No ad torture — our optional short ads are unobtrusive, not screen-hijacking interruptions
* Lifetime Premium for less than the other guys charge per year — pay once, own it forever
* Responsive support — real humans who actually reply

Everything you need to meet your gaols:
* Daily macro, calorie, fiber, and water tracking displayed front and center. No need to hunt for it.
* Fast food logging with personal food icons
* Barcode scanner — scan a label and move on with your day
* Custom foods and meals
* Apple Health integration to earn extra macros from workouts
* Intermittent fasting support
* Flexible, customizable meal times
* Home Screen widget
* Free
